'''Anantapar''' was a tropical [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Waterworld/Legends|waterworld]] located in the [[Yarith sector/Legends|Yarith sector]]. Situated on the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|hyperlane]], it had a primitive ecosystem that was based around [[Shellfish/Legends|shellfish]] and featured relatively small creatures.

==Description==
Anantapar was a rarely visited [[Waterworld/Legends|waterworld]] located in the [[Anantapar system/Legends|Anantapar system]], a part of the [[Yarith sector/Legends|Yarith sector]]. It was situated in the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region within the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The world lay on the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]], which connected it to the [[Shuxl system/Legends|Shuxl system]] and the neighboring [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector's]] [[Mataou system/Legends|Mataou system]]. Anantapar was located inside the [[Ivax Nebula/Legends|Ivax Nebula]].<ref name="TEA" />

Anantapar featured a tropical climate and at least one [[Ocean/Legends|sea]]. It had a primitive ecosystem that appeared to be evolving around [[Shellfish/Legends|shellfish]], and the largest [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Water/Legends|marine]] creature was no larger than the [[Limb/Legends|palm]] of a [[Human/Legends|Human]].<ref name="GG" />

==History==
After the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] victory in a [[Galactic Republic–Mugaari war|war]] against the nearby civilization of the [[Mugaari]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="GG" /> at some point between approximately [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] and [[600 BBY/Legends|600 BBY]],<ref name="MugaariDate">{{RepublicMugaariWarDate}}</ref> the former established the [[Javin sector/Legends|Javin sector]] in the former [[Mugaari Space/Legends|Mugaari Space]].<ref name="GG" /> Around [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]],<ref name="SectorDates" /> the portion of the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] containing Anantapar was re-designated as the Anoat sector, and generations after that, the Anoat itself was further split into two parts, with Anantapar becoming a part of the new Yarith sector.<ref name="GG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Anantapar was introduced in [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement "[[Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin]]," which was published on [[Wizards.com]] on [[March 25]], [[2004]].<ref name="GG" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the world in grid square K-18.<ref name="TEA" />
